preconditions.description: The number of queries Q is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 10**18 and 1 <= q <= 10**18 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each query parameter p and q are between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= cnt for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().split()[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, R is a valid node index (1 ≤ R ≤ current node count).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= W <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().split()[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, W is a weight between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= X <= 10**15 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().split()[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, X is a sum constraint between 0 and 10^15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: cnt == 1 and all(line.strip().split()[0] == '1' or line.strip().split()[0] == '2' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The tree starts with a single node (index 1, weight 0), and all queries are either type 1 or type 2.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['1 p q', '2 p q'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each query line is either a type 1 (add node) or type 2 (query sequence) with two parameters.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.strip() == str(last_answer) for output_line, last_answer in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [0] + [int(line.split()[1]) ^ int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().split()[0] == '2']))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, the output is the length of the longest valid sequence starting at R with sum of weights ≤ X, where X is computed as p XOR last_answer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= answer <= cnt for answer in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: Each output answer is a valid sequence length between 1 and the current node count.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= sum_weights <= X for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().split()[0] == '2' for sum_weights in [sum(w for w in sequence_weights) for sequence_weights in valid_sequences(line)])
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, every valid sequence's weight sum does not exceed X (computed as p XOR last_answer).

postconditions.expression: all(all(w[i] >= w[j] for i, j in zip(sequence[:-1], sequence[1:]) if is_ancestor(i, j)) and not any(w[k] >= w[j] for i, j in zip(sequence[:-1], sequence[1:]) if is_ancestor(i, j) for k in path_between(i, j)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().split()[0] == '2' for sequence in valid_sequences(line))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, every valid sequence satisfies the weight non-increasing condition and no intermediate node k on the path from i to j violates w[k] ≥ w[j].
